title: Balaghat Malaria Outbreak : Baiga community plea to CM Mohan Yadav. #cmmohanyadav #balaghat #adiwasi
ground_truth: Local reports and community accounts detail 25 deaths within the vulnerable Baiga tribe, exacerbated by contaminated stream water sources and a complete lack of mandated nutrition rations.
official_record: Official Balaghat government statements recognize only 8 deaths and contain no formal acknowledgment of missing nutrition rations or systemic stream water contamination issues in the affected regions.
context_gap: A major discrepancy of 17 undocumented deaths exists between official tallies (8) and local reporting (25). Additionally, the official narrative completely overlooks the structural failures driving the outbreak, namely the delivery of missing nutrition rations and the ongoing consumption of contaminated stream water by the Baiga community.
